The street combines sourced place facts with an original, simplified 3D interpretation. The four architecture photographs below guide façade shape and materials; their pixels are not used as scene textures. Separate licensed environment photographs provide lighting and reflections. The photographers do not endorse this project.

这条街结合了有来源的地点事实与原创的简化三维表达。以下四张建筑照片为立面造型和材质提供视觉参考，其像素未用作场景贴图；另行授权的环境照片用于光照与反射。摄影作者未为本项目背书。

Architecture photographs / 建筑照片

Use and changes for all four references: Visual reference for original simplified façade geometry and materials; photograph pixels are not included. Shapes and finishes are interpreted, not measured reproductions. Capture dates describe the photographs; they do not guarantee present-day appearance, entrances or access.

Day & night environments / 日间与夜间环境光

Lighting and reflections use two photographic environment maps from Poly Haven, under CC0 1.0 Universal. They were captured in London and Berlin and provide an artistic lighting reference. They are not shown as a panorama background and do not describe Kyoto's actual lighting or surroundings.

光照与反射使用两张来自 Poly Haven、遵循 CC0 1.0 的摄影环境图。它们拍摄于伦敦和柏林，用于艺术化光照参考，不作为全景背景展示，也不代表京都的实际光照或周边环境。

Andreas Mischok · London / 伦敦 · 2019-09-14 · CC0 1.0

Greg Zaal · Berlin / 柏林 · 2016-11-06 · CC0 1.0

Asset and creator / 资源与作者 · Official download records / 官方下载记录

Use and changes: exact official 1024 × 512 HDR downloads, renamed locally; no pixel edits. Lighting intensity, orientation and exposure are authored. The two files are not a measured day/night pair. Provider license · Sources, file hashes and use records / 来源、文件校验值与使用记录.

使用与改动：采用官方 1024 × 512 HDR 文件，仅更改本地文件名，未修改像素。光照强度、方向和曝光经过设计调整；两张文件并非经过测量校准的昼夜组合。

Map data & place facts / 地图数据与地点事实

© OpenStreetMap contributors. Building spans and crossing positions use OpenStreetMap data under the Open Database License (ODbL) 1.0. Geometry source extract. Materials, model heights, interaction points and unassigned doors include authored approximations.

建筑沿街范围与横道位置使用 OpenStreetMap 数据，遵循 ODbL 1.0。材质、模型高度、互动位置和未匹配租户的门包含设计近似值。到达游戏互动点不等于现实到访或事实核验。

Expanded intersection geometry and source hashes / 扩展路口几何与来源校验值. The visual context includes mapped building footprints, road and sidewalk centrelines, hedges and a tree. Display widths and heights are interpreted; additional surroundings do not establish walkable access or new venue encounters.

扩展场景使用地图中的建筑轮廓、道路与人行道中心线、绿篱和树木位置。展示宽度与高度包含设计近似值；画面里的周边环境不代表新增可步行路线或地点体验。

Service and access details are paraphrased from the operators linked inside each encounter. Operator fact sources and review dates / 运营方事实来源与核对日期.

Software & fonts / 软件与字体

The scene uses Three.js, licensed under MIT. UI text uses a renamed subset of Noto Sans CJK (“Kyoto Sans”); the model's lettering also uses Noto. The font remains under the SIL Open Font License 1.1.

三维场景使用 MIT 许可的 Three.js。界面使用重命名为「Kyoto Sans」的 Noto Sans CJK 字体子集，模型文字也使用 Noto 字体；字体遵循 SIL Open Font License 1.1。

sourceScope.en: Mapped footprints and existing geometry are unchanged. Day/night fixture placement, colours and intensity are authored; no actual opening, occupancy or interior claim. Licensed external HDRIs illuminate and reflect only.
sourceScope.zh: 地图建筑轮廓及现有几何保持不变。日夜灯具位置、颜色与强度为设计表达，不代表真实营业、房间使用或室内状态。获许可外部 HDRI 仅用于照明与反射。

renderDifference.en: Shared geometry, cameras and authored lighting rig. A uses PMREM and cached shadow maps; B uses calibrated Cycles power, indirect light and emissive bounce. B limits daylight HDR diffuse radiance to avoid a second solar shadow, while retaining full HDR for glossy reflections. Powers, falloff and haze are not physically identical. B is a fixed image, not path-traced play.
renderDifference.zh: 共用几何、相机及设计灯光配置。A 使用 PMREM 和缓存阴影；B 使用校准后的 Cycles 功率、间接光和发光反弹。B 限制日间 HDR 漫反射辐亮度以避免第二道太阳阴影，镜面反射保留完整 HDR。光功率、衰减与雾效并非物理一致；B 是固定图片，并非路径追踪游玩。

day.basis: Suppress the HDR solar disc as a competing diffuse key; source HDR bytes unchanged.

sourceScope.zh: 地图建筑轮廓及现有几何保持不变。日夜灯具位置、颜色与强度为设计表达，不代表真实营业、房间使用或室内状态。获许可外部 HDRI 仅用于照明与反射。

renderDifference.en: Shared geometry, cameras and authored lighting rig. A uses PMREM and cached shadow maps; B uses calibrated Cycles power, indirect light and emissive bounce. B limits daylight HDR diffuse radiance to avoid a second solar shadow, while retaining full HDR for glossy reflections. Powers, falloff and haze are not physically identical. B is a fixed image, not path-traced play.
renderDifference.zh: 共用几何、相机及设计灯光配置。A 使用 PMREM 和缓存阴影；B 使用校准后的 Cycles 功率、间接光和发光反弹。B 限制日间 HDR 漫反射辐亮度以避免第二道太阳阴影，镜面反射保留完整 HDR。光功率、衰减与雾效并非物理一致；B 是固定图片，并非路径追踪游玩。

day.basis: Suppress the HDR solar disc as a competing diffuse key; source HDR bytes unchanged.

manifest.producerPolicy: Per-render renderScriptSha256 records the producer when unchanged images are preserved; top-level hash is the current manifest writer.

limitations: Agent/automation evidence is not human art, fluency or immersion acceptance.
Software GPU timings are not desktop hardware performance acceptance.
Headless Chromium does not reproduce real tab focus changes here; focus-loss cleanup uses an injected blur event.
Native sharing uses an observed API stub, not an OS share sheet or recipient delivery. Browser PDF output does not establish every OS printer.
HTTP packaged-resource loading is exercised; native file:// launch requires a browser environment permitting that scheme.
status: Browser walkthrough completed; independent visual review and human acceptance remain separate.
